'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
